messages:
julia_partnerships: FYI MediScience (acct MS-302) asked for a retroactive reseller discount on INV-2026-4601. They claim deployment delays caused lower usage; requesting 25% credit on that invoice + a partner pricing addendum for future deals. Thoughts?

omar_sales_apac: They
re a strategic APAC reseller, close to onboarding two customers. If we push back hard they may pause the pilots. Recommend credit the invoice (25% = $22,500) but require an amended reseller MSA for future pricing.

len_finance: Anything >$10k needs deal desk + documented exec exception. Is INV-2026-4601 posted? What's the billing period and net effect on revenue recognition?

julia_partnerships: Invoice posted 2026-06-02 for May usage. Net impact: $22.5k credit would be booked as contra-revenue this month; we need GL and NetSuite memo.

aya_revops: Suggest split resolution: 1) one-time credit limited to INV-2026-4601, 2) require signed partner addendum that includes clear SLOs and onboarding timelines, 3) make future discounts conditional on minimum commit. That avoids precedent.

sophie_cx: MediScience is pushing for fast turnaround. They want the credit applied before next billing cycle or they may escalate to their procurement team.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-105 created (amount $22,500). Status: awaiting finance approval.

len_finance: Ian provisionally approve pending: 1) exec sign-off for >$10k, 2) partner addendum drafted by RevOps/legal, 3) GL 7302 recorded and NetSuite note referencing exception. Send one-line business justification for deal desk packet.
omar_sales_apac: One-liner: "Strategic APAC reseller onboarding; credit to preserve pilot momentum and secure ~USD 360k ARR pipeline."

julia_partnerships: I'll collect legal & exec sign-off. If CFO signs, proceed to post CM-2026-105 and attach the partner addendum. Marking tracking: billing post, legal addendum, exec approval.

len_finance: If CFO approves, finance will post CM and tag as "Reseller exception - exec approved".

julia_partnerships: Thanks team. I'll loop in legal and follow up with the reseller. Marking thread pending until exec sign-off and CM posting. :pray:
